description: This file provides high-level utility functions for creating and manipulating AST nodes related to shader translation, including node creation, variable handling, and function lookup within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: TIntermFunctionPrototype
classes.description: Represents a function prototype in the AST.

classes.name: TIntermFunctionDefinition
classes.description: Represents a function definition in the AST.

classes.name: TIntermTyped
classes.description: Base class for all typed AST nodes.

classes.name: TConstantUnion
classes.description: Holds constant values for AST nodes.

classes.name: TType
classes.description: Represents a data type in the AST.

classes.name: TVariable
classes.description: Represents a variable in the AST.

classes.name: TIntermSymbol
classes.description: Represents a symbol node in the AST.

classes.name: TIntermDeclaration
classes.description: Represents a variable declaration in the AST.

classes.name: TIntermBinary
classes.description: Represents a binary operation node in the AST.

classes.name: TIntermAggregate
classes.description: Represents an aggregate function call or constructor.

methods.name: LookUpBuiltInFunction
methods.description: Looks up a built-in function by name and arguments in the symbol table.

methods.name: CreateInternalFunctionPrototypeNode
methods.description: Creates a function prototype node from a TFunction.

methods.name: CreateInternalFunctionDefinitionNode
methods.description: Creates a function definition node with a given function and body.

methods.name: CreateZeroNode
methods.description: Creates a node representing zero value for a given type.

methods.name: CreateTempVariable
methods.description: Creates a temporary variable with specified type and qualifier.

methods.name: CreateTempSymbolNode
methods.description: Creates a symbol node for a temporary variable.

methods.name: CreateTempDeclarationNode
methods.description: Creates a declaration node for a temporary variable.

methods.name: CreateTempInitDeclarationNode
methods.description: Creates an initialized declaration node for a temporary variable.

methods.name: CreateTempAssignmentNode
methods.description: Creates an assignment node for a temporary variable.

methods.name: DeclareTempVariable
methods.description: Declares and creates a temporary variable with optional initializer.

methods.name: DeclareInterfaceBlock
methods.description: Defines an interface block and inserts it into the AST.

methods.name: EnsureBlock
methods.description: Ensures a node is a block, wrapping it if necessary.

methods.name: ReferenceGlobalVariable
methods.description: Creates a symbol node referencing a global variable.

methods.name: ReferenceBuiltInVariable
methods.description: Creates a symbol node referencing a built-in variable.

methods.name: CreateBuiltInFunctionCallNode
methods.description: Creates a node representing a call to a built-in function.
